sourceEvidence: apps/api/src/modules/audit/models.ts enforces immutable insert-only audit records and query-driven indexes.
apps/api/src/modules/audit/redaction.ts and writer.ts redact bounded snapshots before persistence; repository.ts redacts again before response delivery.
apps/api/src/modules/audit/router.ts exposes GET /api/v1/admin/audit-logs and GET /api/v1/admin/audit-logs/:auditId behind verified Admin authentication and admin:audit.view.
apps/api/src/modules/accounts/repository.ts and apps/api/src/modules/rbac/repository.ts write the protected mutation and audit record in the same MongoDB transaction.
apps/api/src/modules/uploads/runtime.ts prevents issuing a private-document access grant if persistent audit recording fails and never records the signed URL.
apps/api/tests/audit and synchronized OpenAPI/Postman validation provide deterministic contract, redaction, authorization, IDOR-safe lookup, append-only, transaction-failure, and route evidence.

Files outside the atomic Allowed Roots were limited to packages/contracts/src/contracts/index.ts and packages/contracts/src/rbac/index.ts for public contract export/reason-bearing RBAC DTO synchronization; apps/api/src/app.ts, apps/api/src/server.ts, accounts/repository.ts, accounts/runtime.ts, rbac/repository.ts, rbac/router.ts, rbac/runtime.ts, rbac/service.ts, and uploads/runtime.ts for mandatory runtime mounting and same-transaction/fail-closed audit integration; apps/api/src/modules/docs/api-artifacts.ts and testing/test-suites.ts for inventory/test registration; and the four affected RBAC tests for the now-mandatory reason and audit contract. These integrations are necessary to expose and verify the selected task and do not implement another task.
ADM-66 metadata remains the supporting Admin Audit Log surface reference; this backend task has no direct screen implementation.
